fusions.name: Barbed Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a hooked hatchet that deals 12 damage and has a 50% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Ripping Pull
fusions.desc: Rakes the axe back in a cone that deals 8 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you and makes each target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Haul Line
fusions.desc: Lays a hooked line 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it toward it.

fusions.name: Caught Then Cut
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
